nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, set to msg.sender in constructor and used as the sole privileged account for delegate and list.
Address of the external Ferrum launch protection contract invoked through an unchecked low-level call in the checkBots modifier.
Uniswap V2 pair address computed in the constructor and forwarded to the bot protection call.
Public mapping holding token balances; mutated directly with unchecked += and -= in transferFrom and overwritten in list.
Public nested mapping of owner/spender allowances, written in approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Fixed public total supply constant of 13000000000000000000000000 used in the list distribution math.
Uniswap V2 router interface instance used for addLiquidityETH during liquidity listing.
Canonical WETH address used together with the token address to derive the pair in pairFor.
Modifier that performs an unchecked external call to botProtection and requires the first returned boolean before executing the function body.
Payable public transfer entry point that simply forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source.
Payable public transferFrom with the checkBots modifier; performs allowance and balance checks then raw unchecked balance/allowance mutations before emitting Transfer.
Payable public approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without any checks.
Owner-only function that executes an arbitrary delegatecall to an attacker-supplied address and calldata.
Internal pure helper that deterministically derives the Uniswap V2 pair address via keccak256 of sorted tokens and the init code hash.
Owner-only liquidity listing function that overwrites balances, calls addLiquidityETH with a block.timestamp deadline, and distributes tokens in a loop.
rxDoge constructor: sets owner to msg.sender, derives uniPair, and grants infinite allowances to the router and to msg.sender on the pair.
Attacker-controlled caller address used for ownership checks, allowance keys, transfers and approvals.
Miner-influenced timestamp used as the addLiquidityETH deadline (block.timestamp + 600).
Unchecked low-level call to botProtection inside the checkBots modifier using abi.encodeWithSelector(0x15274141, ...) with no success/return validation of the target contract.
Arbitrary delegatecall to address a with calldata b, executing foreign code in the token's storage context.
External payable call to the Uniswap router addLiquidityETH with msg.value and a timestamp-based deadline.
Raw unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed outside SafeMath (Solidity ^0.7.0 has no automatic overflow checks).
Raw unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value that can overflow silently.
Raw unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value guarded only by a require comparison.
Public token name string 'rxDoge'.
Public token symbol string 'rDOGE'.
Public constant decimals value 18.
Destination address _to of the transfer function.
Amount _value of the transfer function, forwarded to transferFrom.
Source address _from of transferFrom, used as the balance and allowance key.
Destination address _to of transferFrom, credited with the transferred value.
Amount _value of transferFrom, used in the allowance and balance arithmetic.
Spender address _spender given an allowance in approve.
Allowance amount _value written in approve.
Arbitrary target address a of the delegatecall in delegate.
Arbitrary calldata b passed to the delegatecall in delegate.
Amount _numList of tokens set as the contract balance and used for liquidity provision.
Recipient array _tos for the token distribution loop in list.
Amount array _amounts assigned to each recipient in the distribution loop.
Constructor argument _botProtection stored into the botProtection state variable.
Modifier parameter _from forwarded as the first argument of the bot protection external call.
Modifier parameter _to forwarded as the second argument of the bot protection external call.
Modifier parameter _value forwarded as the last argument of the bot protection external call.
Local boolean capturing the first return value of the bot protection call and passed to require.
Local bytes variable capturing the second, unused return value of the bot protection call.
Loop index controlling the token distribution loop in list.
